code-reviewer.when_to_use: Always. General correctness, data flow, logic errors, broken contracts, security.

simplifier.when_to_use: Diff introduces abstractions, new utilities, refactors, or non-trivial structural change.

silent-failure-hunter.when_to_use: Diff contains try/catch, error handling, fallbacks, or async flows.

test-auditor.when_to_use: Diff changes behavior, contracts, or business logic. Always for plan/fix verification.

consistency-auditor.when_to_use: Diff touches an area with established patterns, a spec/plan we just wrote, or a reference implementation worth comparing against.
